title: Build frontend seeder page with premium type selection, upload, dry-run preview, and confirm workflow
description: Create a new React page for the premium Excel seeder workflow. The page guides users through: (1) select premium type from dropdown (populated from GET /premium-definitions), (2) set period month/year and division code, (3) upload Excel file or download blank template first, (4) click 'Preview' to run dry-run and see what will be imported, (5) review dry-run summary table showing per-row actions, (6) confirm to execute import with progress bar, (7) view final import results.

files.change: Create full PremiumSeederPage component with stepper workflow: Step 1 (Setup: premium type selector, period inputs, division selector, file upload + template download button), Step 2 (Dry-Run Preview: summary cards showing total rows/amount/inserts/updates/errors, scrollable table with per-row action classification), Step 3 (Import Results: progress bar during import, final success/error summary with counts).
Add route for /premium-seeder pointing to PremiumSeederPage component.
Add 'Seeder Premi' menu item in sidebar navigation linking to /premium-seeder.

implementation: Create PremiumSeederPage.jsx with multi-step workflow state machine (step: 'setup' | 'preview' | 'importing' | 'result')

Step 1 - Setup: Fetch premium definitions from GET /premium-definitions, populate dropdown with active blok types only. Add period month (MonthSelector component), period year (number input), division code (dropdown from DivisionConfig). Add file upload area (react-dropzone or native input). Add 'Download Template' button that calls GET /premium-seeder/template.

Step 2 - Dry-Run Preview: Upload button calls POST /premium-seeder/dry-run. Show loading spinner during API call. Display summary cards: Total Rows, Total Amount, Ready to Insert (count), Would Update (count), Duplicates/Skipped (count), Errors (count). Show scrollable table (virtualized for >100 rows) with columns: EmpCode, Premium Type, Gang, Amount, Items, Action (color-coded badge), Reason.

Step 3 - Confirm Import: User reviews preview and clicks 'Konfirmasi Import'. Calls POST /premium-seeder/import. Show progress bar with percentage and current step text. On completion, show success summary: imported count, updated count, skipped count, errors list. Add 'Import Lagi' button to reset workflow.
Error handling: API errors shown as toast notifications. Network failures allow retry. File validation (must be .xlsx, max 10MB) before upload.
Add PremiumSeederPage route in App.jsx: <Route path='/premium-seeder' element={<PremiumSeederPage />} />
Add navigation menu item in DashboardLayout.jsx sidebar under 'Data Import' section

reference.pattern: Existing page patterns: DetailedSalaryAnalysisPage.jsx for data tables, ProfessionalDashboard.jsx for dashboard cards, MonthSelector.jsx for period selection
reference.examples: DetailedSalaryAnalysisPage.jsx demonstrates data table with loading states. ProfessionalDashboard.jsx shows summary card pattern with color-coded badges. MonthSelector.jsx provides reusable period month picker.

criteria: Premium type dropdown populated from GET /premium-definitions with blok-only types
File upload accepts .xlsx and validates size (max 10MB)
Template download button generates and downloads correct .xlsx file
Dry-run preview shows summary cards with correct counts and per-row table
Import progress bar updates during import (polling or long-polling from API)
Success/error summary displayed after import completes
Entire workflow navigable: setup -> preview -> confirm -> result -> reset

rationale.chosen_approach: Single page with stepper workflow (setup -> preview -> importing -> result). Uses existing MonthSelector component. Dry-run preview display mandatory before import confirmation. Follows existing page design patterns for consistency.
alternatives_considered: Modal dialog instead of full page
Two separate pages: one for upload, one for results
Inline import in existing ProfessionalDashboard page
decision_factors: User experience: stepper guides non-technical operators through workflow
Reusability: existing MonthSelector and table components reduce code
Consistency: follows existing page layout pattern
rationale.tradeoffs: Full page adds navigation complexity but provides better UX for multi-step workflow than modal. Stepper enforces correct sequence (preview before commit).

manual_checks: Navigate to /premium-seeder, verify premium types load in dropdown
Download template for PREMI KINERJA, fill with test data, upload
Verify dry-run preview shows correct row classifications
Confirm import and verify progress bar updates
Verify navigation menu item appears and links correctly
success_metrics: Page loads and renders within 2 seconds
Dry-run API response displayed within 5 seconds for 100-row file
Import progress updates every 2 seconds during processing
